classification: exploratory feasibility only; does not establish production/admission eligibility

method.input: synthetic, in-memory only; no repository/data copies
method.layers: 20 daily QE quantile IDs precomputed for native streams; half-lives linspace(1,60,20)
method.native_sort_restore: asset/date sort before recurrence, then original row-index restoration
method.e2e_boundary: QE assign_daily_quantiles plus published FP recurrence versus QE assignment plus Polars frame construction/sort, 40 adjusted EWM streams, alpha-weighted mass reconstruction and original-order restoration
method.validation: fixture is unique, dense and date-monotone; duplicate/invalid-frame rejection overhead not included

tie_gap_diagnostic_seed8092.note: Relative-only miss is concentrated at near-zero/cancellation outputs; mask is equal and max absolute error is below 1e-14.

dense_480x3000.strict_relative_only_note: 1016 finite outputs exceed 1e-12 relative error, concentrated near cancellation/zero; absolute error remains below 4e-15

float64_extreme.tested: alternating signs over 80 dates x 4 assets and 20 changing layers

timing_s.interpretation: Polars prototype was about 1.58x slower end-to-end for this dense sorted/restored fixture; raw stream throughput alone does not justify a default switch.

numeric_envelope.tested_probes: fixed /20 scale; rho derived from h in [1,60]; discrete magnitudes 1e-300 and float64_max/10 passed; float64_max produced one nonfinite output; tiny probes at 1e-300, 1e-310, 1e-320
numeric_envelope.conservative_fallback: fallback to published FP scale-normalized recurrence when nonzero inputs may be below 1e-300 or above float64_max/10; boundaries are conservative, discrete probes only
numeric_envelope.future_scale_rule: no future-derived segment maximum or value scaling used
numeric_envelope.not_certified: No production module, FE integration, or production eligibility conclusion follows from these probes.

reproduction.saved_measurement: The script was authored after this measurement and was not re-run at 480x3000 to avoid competing with the main agent's F48 test.
